what: Dependency version bump zod 3 (S01-S05) -> zod 4 (S06+). After the bump, the candidate must reference zod 4 and must not present zod 3 as the current validation library (historical/migration framing is fine).

steps.candidate:
# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- Invoice fixtures under tests/fixtures/invoices/ are the ground truth for payload shapes; all 96 validation cases pass [seed, note qa-s01, note qa-s03].
- One route per resource; handlers stay thin, domain logic lives in src/domain/ [note 0].
- Standardize on axios for all outbound HTTP calls; retry logic in response interceptors, auth in request interceptors [note qa-s02].
- Log via winston at warn level for retries; one logger instance per module [note qa-s05].
- Use ESLint import-order rule (alphabetical within files) to catch merge conflicts early [note qa-s01, note qa-s03].
- Use zod 3 with .strict() for invoice payloads; mirror schema structure for credit notes; flatten errors for response mapping [note qa-s03, note qa-s04].

## Known pitfalls
- Express error handler returns 400 for validation failures (mapped from zod .flatten()), 500 otherwise [note 1, note qa-s03].
- Prefer standard library functions over hand-rolled logic [note 2].
- Ensure card numbers are redacted from logs using standard redaction paths [note qa-s04].

# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- Invoice fixtures under tests/fixtures/invoices/ are the ground truth for payload shapes; all 96 validation cases pass [seed, note qa-s01, note qa-s03].
- One route per resource; handlers stay thin, domain logic lives in src/domain/ [note 0].
- Use native fetch for all outbound HTTP; retry logic via small hand-rolled wrapper [note qa-s10, note qa-s12].
- Log via pino; one logger instance per module [note qa-s11, note qa-s12].
- Use ESLint import-order rule (type-grouped: node builtins, external, internal aliases, relative) to catch merge conflicts early [note qa-s07, note qa-s11].
- Use zod 4 with z.strictObject() for invoice payloads; mirror schema structure for credit notes; map issues using zod 4 error format [note qa-s06, note qa-s12].
- Ensure card numbers are redacted from pino logs using standard redaction paths [note qa-s04, note qa-s11].

## Known pitfalls
- Express error handler returns 400 for validation failures (mapped from zod issue list), 500 otherwise [note qa-s03, note qa-s06].
- Prefer standard library functions over hand-rolled logic [note 2].
- Avoid async logging transports (e.g., winston) under load due to data-loss risk; use synchronous pino transports [note qa-s08, note qa-s11].

## Task playbooks
- When migrating HTTP client, verify against existing integration suite before removing old dependencies [note qa-s10].
- When upgrading zod major versions, update error mappers to match the new issue list structure [note qa-s06].
